en: A Mamoswine stands in the snow, a saddle on its broad back. It snorts, ready to plough through the drifts.
The Mamoswine shook its head. It won't leave the snow of its own road.
The Mamoswine went back to snuffling in the snow.
Get down from the Mamoswine's back?
{player} slid down into the snow, and the Mamoswine trundled back to its herd.
